name: OKR Studio
tagline: Quarterly goals your team can actually measure
about: OKR Studio drafts objectives and key results from your strategy, scores them for quality, cascades them to teams, runs weekly check-ins and grades the quarter honestly.
persona: You are an OKR coach who has run planning at fast-growing startups: outcome-obsessed, ruthless about vanity metrics, and clear that OKRs are not a task list.

onboarding.title: Fewer goals, better goals
onboarding.subtitle: Your company context makes the goals specific.

tools.title: Draft company OKRs
tools.subtitle: Strategy → measurable objectives

inputs.label: Strategy / priorities in your words
inputs.placeholder: cut churn, launch mobile app, raise Series A in Q3

tools.prompt: Draft {count} company objectives from: {strategy}, for the profile company and its quarterly theme. Table (Objective | Key result | Baseline | Target | Suggested owner | Leading or lagging), bullets explaining why each objective earns its place, and a callout listing what was deliberately left out and why.

tools.title: Score my OKRs
tools.subtitle: Outputs vs outcomes, measurability

inputs.label: Paste your OKRs
inputs.placeholder: O1: Delight customers. KR1: Ship 5 features…

tools.prompt: Score these OKRs: {okrs}. Table (Item | Outcome or output? | Measurable? | Ambitious? | Score /10 | Rewrite), a callout on the most common failure pattern seen here, and a checklist of edits to make before publishing them.

tools.title: Cascade to a team
tools.subtitle: Team KRs that ladder up
tools.prompt: Cascade the company objective '{parent}' to the {teamname} team as 3–4 team key results. Table (Team KR | How it ladders up | Metric source | Weekly check), steps for a 45-minute team OKR workshop, and bullets of cross-team dependencies to surface early.

tools.title: Weekly check-in
tools.subtitle: Confidence, blockers, next actions

inputs.label: This week's numbers & notes
inputs.placeholder: KR1 at 40% (target 50% by now), KR2 blocked on data team

tools.prompt: Run a weekly OKR check-in on: {progress}. Table (KR | Confidence: green / amber / red | Why | Next action | Owner), bullets of the 3 things to discuss at Monday's meeting, and a quote with a 4-line Slack update for the company.

tools.title: Grade the quarter
tools.subtitle: Honest scores and lessons

inputs.label: Final results per KR
inputs.placeholder: KR1: 0.7, KR2: hit, KR3: missed badly because…

tools.prompt: Grade the quarter from: {results}. Table (KR | Score 0–1 | Verdict | Lesson), text with an honest 5-sentence narrative for the all-hands, bullets of what to carry, kill or reset next quarter, and a callout on whether the misses were ambition or execution.
